environment.description: AWS Lambda function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The compiled C binary runs as a custom Lambda runtime (provided.al2023). The function URL is publicly accessible at https://xxxxxxxx.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/ with no authentication required. Any internet client can POST arbitrary binary payloads directly to the handler. The Lambda execution environment uses glibc 2.34 with no heap hardening beyond default tcache. No WAF, no API Gateway, no CloudFront distribution in front.
